description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: npm run check and npm run build pass; electron . smoke test opened a 1200x800 window with contextIsolation enabled and preload script attached, no console errors

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: DocumentList component renders sidebar entries with title and chunk count, shows empty-state message when no documents; import flow adds entries via documents:import IPC

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: QuestionPanel component submits via qa:ask IPC; QaService returns grounded answers with citations (15 vitest tests pass covering import, indexing, and QA)

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService.init() creates userData/knowledge-base-data on startup; atomic JSON writes and content/chunks files verified by services.test.ts against a temp data dir
